headline: Colonials Claim All of Callahan's Passage as Expanse Fray Intensifies
war_summary: Callahan's Passage supplies the morning's sensation: where our last edition recorded a nine-to-one split, every one of its ten posts now flies Colonial colours, Crumbling Post the most contested ground with eleven actions. The Weathered Expanse swings almost by the hour — the count now stands four Colonial posts to three Warden, with two grounds demolished, sixty-one actions logged in the day and Wightwalk worked over thirty times; the guns were heard up to the hour of filing. Mooring County, lately reduced to a single Colonial post, has recovered three of twelve, with Gravekeeper's Holdfast drawing seventeen actions and fresh reports arriving as this edition went to press. The Nevish Line keeps its five-to-three Warden alignment but has gone quiet for some six hours, and Palantine Berm's seven Warden posts likewise stand untroubled since the early hours. Elsewhere the ledger grows by attrition rather than assault, the Dead Lands and Marban Hollow casualty columns climbing steeply. Day 542; thirty-four victory towns remain unclaimed and no victor is named.
